ctx.x: What about, did you ever play in any dining rooms, or restaurants, or anything like that?

I used to play behind uh, uh, those synth, the orchestras used to uh, am I saying right? Mm-hmm. To come to the auditorium? Mm-hmm. Well uh, Mr. Leon Garccio, I played so many parties, and he had uh, they had a big uh, to do that hotel lab. He called me, he said, Julius, I said, he said, come by the uh, Roosevelt. He said, come to somewhere, he told me, come by the bar, I want to talk with you. Well, they had one of those big things going on over there, I said, nah, he wants six pieces, I don't know how to do…

You remember this baseball park used to be out there? Tynalyn Park? Yeah. I used to be out there a lot too. Pelican Stadium they called it Lady Air. Pelican Stadium, yeah. I used to play with all of them.
